svg.title: Git Home page system wireframes v1
svg.desc: Wireframes for the Git Home supporting page system: apps index, single app case study, art gallery, single artwork, and about page.

text.tspan: A library of working ideas, each framed around
what it solves, why it exists, and what I learned.

g.text: How can prompt testing feel less chaotic?
Kolam as culture, structure, and visual learning.
Pattern generation as a playful design system.

text.tspan: A case-study page that explains the product thought,
the interface choices, and the build decisions.

g.text: Why it exists / product thinking / UX decisions / screenshots / what I learned

text.tspan: A visual archive of sketches, studies, experiments,
A short note about the piece, what I was observing,
and how it connects to pattern, interface rhythm, or craft.
A profile page that reads like a thoughtful story, not a resume dump.

g.text: currently: exploring AI, product design, local-first tools

text.tspan: A local-only editor for apps, artwork, page copy, quotes,

g.text: mode: local content editor / export JSON
Download updated JSON and assets map
1. Terminal shloka wraps naturally on desktop and tablet; mobile can stack transliteration/translation below the Sanskrit line.
2. Apps index becomes an app-like vertical list on mobile, with large tap targets and persistent bottom links.
3. Single app pages prioritize story first, screenshot second; screenshots are evidence, not decoration.
4. Art gallery can use masonry on desktop and simple two-column / one-column cards on mobile.
5. Admin is local-only and writes structured content: site, apps, artwork, quotes, theme.
